About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Senior Embedded Systems Engineer – RF Systems
About The Role
We are seeking a
Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
with deep expertise in RF systems to lead the design, development, and optimization of embedded platforms that enable next-generation wireless technologies. This role is highly technical and research-driven, requiring mastery of embedded software, hardware integration, and RF system-level performance.
Key Responsibilities
System Architecture & Design
Define and implement embedded system architectures for RF front-end and transceiver platforms.
Develop firmware and low-level drivers for RF control, calibration, and signal processing.
Integrate RF hardware (PAs, LNAs, filters, tuners, switches, transceivers) with embedded software systems.
Research & Development
Explore new embedded control methodologies for adaptive RF systems (beamforming, dynamic tuning, coexistence).
Prototype and validate advanced algorithms for RF calibration, power management, and signal integrity.
Collaborate with silicon and RF design teams to co-optimize hardware/software interfaces.
Validation & Optimization
Develop automated test frameworks for embedded RF systems.
Perform system-level debugging, profiling, and optimization to ensure real-time performance.
Validate compliance with wireless standards (LTE, 5G NR, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) and regulatory requirements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with RF design, hardware, and systems engineering teams to ensure seamless integration.
Provide technical leadership in embedded systems best practices and mentor junior engineers.
Contribute to technical documentation, IP development, and internal knowledge sharing.
Qualifications
Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of experience in embedded systems engineering, with a focus on RF systems.
Strong proficiency in C/C++ and embedded software development for real-time systems.
Experience with microcontrollers, DSPs, FPGAs, and SoCs used in RF applications.
Solid understanding of RF system design, calibration, and control.
Familiarity with lab equipment (spectrum analyzers, VNAs, oscilloscopes) for system validation.
Preferred Skills
Experience with embedded Linux, RTOS, and hardware abstraction layers.
Knowledge of digital signal processing for RF applications.
Familiarity with high-speed interfaces (SPI, I2C, PCIe, Ethernet) in RF systems.
Track record of patents, publications, or contributions to embedded RF technologies.
What We Offer
Opportunity to lead cutting-edge embedded R&D projects in RF systems.
Collaborative environment with access to advanced labs and global engineering teams.
